experience.description: Conduct periodic monitoring and inspections of server operational viability to ensure system stability.
Mengembangkan modul baru pada aplikasi DPD Golkar (aspirasi rakyat & registrasi kader). Mengoptimalkan UI/UX dengan fitur pagination, pengunduhan, dan pull-to-refresh.
Integrating PPOB modules and an article portal into the DEDiGO application. Designing and deploying WebView-based applications for Global Halal Hub, Intani Fresh, and Wakaf MUI services.

Dispatch & Driver System: Developing a logistics driver management application (order status, tagging-based Proof of Delivery, location tracking).
Maintenance System: Building an application for vehicle issue reporting and routine inspections (checksheets).
Logistics Operations System: Designing Gate/Security and Tally/Checker applications to oversee loading and unloading activities.
Internal & Customer Systems: Developing client-facing applications (orders & catalogs) as well as internal HR applications (attendance, work-hour tracking, task management).

Logistics Application Development: Designed and built new applications from scratch to facilitate company operations—specifically, the KIB Driver app (for driver management) and the KIB Tally app (for monitoring cargo loading and unloading).
System Maintenance & Debugging: Conducted routine application stability monitoring, issue analysis, and bug fixing to ensure smooth daily logistics operations.

Service Rental Platform Application Development: End-to-end design and development of two mobile applications—one for clients (service users) and a dedicated app for partners (service providers).
Payment Gateway Integration: Implementation of a secure, automated digital payment system to facilitate seamless service rental transactions within the application.
Interface Implementation (UI/UX Slicing): Precise, pixel-perfect conversion of visual designs into code to ensure the final application aligns with client expectations and specifications.
System Maintenance & Debugging: Monitoring application stability and performing responsive bug fixes to maintain quality and performance for both clients and service providers.

System Development & Integration (Bank Ganesha): Performed UI slicing, API integration, and translated business flows into system functions for banking features (TapCash, PBB tax payments, Debit ATM management, Cardless Cash Withdrawal, and Quick Transactions).
"New Bangga" Project Implementation: Developed application features for the Maspion "New Bangga" project in accordance with Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Change Request (CR) documentation.
System Security & Code Quality: Ensured data security standards by mitigating findings from Security Penetration Testing (Pentest), implementing Unit Testing, and maintaining clean code quality using Flutter Analyze.
Maintenance & Issue Resolution: Conducted operational maintenance—including bug fixing and technical adjustments—responsively based on SLAs and incoming tickets from the bank.
Cross-Project Support & UI Slicing: Executed precise UI/UX slicing for Bank Gamon application features and provided technical support to other banking clients, such as CMB Ganesha and Djoting.

portfolio.title: SIKepusa
portfolio.description: Sikepusa is the official learning reporting application for SD Kepuharjo 1 students. Easily submit your home-learning assignments without worrying about running out of phone storage. Say goodbye to cluttered WhatsApp chats and full galleries—all of your homework data is safely stored on our cloud server, keeping your device's memory completely free and optimized.

portfolio.title: Serviz ID Customer
portfolio.description: Serviz ID is a complete solution to connect users with professional service providers in various fields, such as construction, home repair, painting, electrical installation, plumbing, and many more. This application is designed to make it easier for users to find and hire the services they need quickly, safely and reliably.

portfolio.title: Serviz ID Partner
portfolio.description: Serviz ID Partner is a dedicated platform for service providers to offer, manage and develop their services. Through this application, partners can easily reach more customers, manage work schedules, monitor income, and increase service professionalism.
